# Regression test for #35: sub-component widget fields must be declared on
# the Model struct. Previously the generated model.go used m.label1..m.label4
# inside renderDetailPanel but those fields were not declared → compile error.

# Post-Plan-C the fyne emitter's window-body rendering uses the legacy
# renderStmt() path (compiler_ir.go), which doesn't recognize the
# lower.CreateNode VarStmt shape produced by NoDeclarative lowering.
# Result: the body of each `window` block emits empty `part0..partN`
# placeholders with no widget construction. renderDetailPanel is still
# emitted but its inner body has the same problem, so labels never
# materialize on the Model struct.
#
# Tracked: rewrite renderStmt to consume lowered IR via WalkLowered,
# matching the slot-Func emission path.
skip 'fyne window-body emission empty post-Plan-C (Issue: rewrite renderStmt over lowered IR)'

sngl compile --platform=fyne --lang=go --out=out app.sngl
exists out/model.go

# renderDetailPanel render method must be emitted
grep 'func \(m \*Model\) renderDetailPanel' out/model.go

# label0 from main window's text("header"), labels 1–4 from detailPanel.
# With continued counters the component fields must not restart at 0.
grep 'label1 \*widget\.Label' out/model.go
grep 'label2 \*widget\.Label' out/model.go
grep 'label3 \*widget\.Label' out/model.go
grep 'label4 \*widget\.Label' out/model.go

-- app.sngl --
output { go { fyne } }

struct Issue {
    key string
    summary string
    status string
    assignee string
}

component main {
    var current = Issue{}

    window #app(title="t") {
        vbox {
            text(value="header")
            detailPanel(it=current)
        }
    }
}

component detailPanel(it Issue) {
    vbox {
        text(value=it.key)
        text(value=it.summary)
        text(value=it.status)
        text(value=it.assignee)
    }
}
